run_WorkerServer_RunServer: run a gRPC benchmark worker server that streams server status updates and handles configuration requests
run_WorkerServer_RunClient: run a gRPC benchmark client that creates multiple channels and reports QPS histogram data
create_WorkerServer_create_server: create a gRPC benchmark server with async or generic handlers and optional SSL credentials
create_WorkerServer_create_client_runner: create a closed loop or open loop Poisson client runner for gRPC benchmark testing
call_WorkerServer_CoreCount: call the CoreCount RPC method to return the number of CPU cores on the worker machine
